tomato_early_blight.name: Tomato Early Blight
tomato_early_blight.recommendation: Remove affected lower leaves immediately. Apply copper-based fungicide and avoid overhead watering to reduce canopy humidity.

tomato_late_blight.name: Tomato Late Blight
tomato_late_blight.recommendation: Destroy severely infected plants to prevent spore dispersal. Apply recommended protective fungicide (e.g., Mancozeb) and improve air circulation.

potato_early_blight.name: Potato Early Blight
potato_early_blight.recommendation: Maintain proper crop rotation (avoid solanaceous crops for 2-3 years). Apply preventive fungicide during warm, humid conditions.

potato_blackleg.name: Potato Blackleg
potato_blackleg.recommendation: Use certified disease-free seed tubers. Avoid planting in waterlogged soils and disinfect handling equipment.

rice_blast.name: Rice Blast
rice_blast.recommendation: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization. Maintain optimum field water levels and apply systemic triazole-based fungicides if threshold is breached.

rice_bacterial_leaf_blight.name: Rice Bacterial Leaf Blight
rice_bacterial_leaf_blight.recommendation: Drain field temporarily to reduce bacterial spread. Use resistant varieties and avoid clipping seedling tips during transplanting.

rules.explanation: Tomato + Leaf Spots → tomato_leaf_spots
Tomato leaf spots + Brown spot color → brown_lesions
Brown lesions + Lower leaves affected → early_blight_pattern
Early blight pattern + High humidity → Tomato Early Blight
Tomato leaf spots + Water-soaked spots → water_soaked_lesions
Water-soaked lesions + Mold growth → late_blight_pattern
Late blight pattern + High humidity → Tomato Late Blight
Potato + Leaf Spots → potato_leaf_spots
Potato leaf spots + Concentric rings → potato_ring_lesions
Potato ring lesions + Lower leaves affected → potato_early_blight_pattern
Potato early blight pattern → Potato Early Blight
Potato + Black stem base → potato_stem_blackened
Potato stem blackened + Wilting → blackleg_pattern
Blackleg pattern + High humidity → Potato Blackleg
Rice + Leaf lesions → rice_lesions
Rice lesions + Spindle-shaped spots → spindle_lesions_present
Spindle lesions present + High humidity → rice_blast_pattern
Rice blast pattern → Rice Blast
Rice + Leaf lesions → rice_leaf_lesions_alt
Rice lesions + Yellow wavy stripes → yellow_wavy_lesions
Yellow wavy lesions + Wilting → bacterial_blight_pattern
Bacterial blight pattern → Rice Bacterial Leaf Blight
